answer: My answer to sybils is Cross-chain DAO vote receipt verification — a vote receipt from a DAO on another chain — which makes the zephyr of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Honest agents barely notice the check, because a vote receipt from a DAO on another chain is something they already have; the knoll falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The ripple grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
